brief:
Hundreds of Palestinians gathered for mass funerals for approximately 105 people whose remains were recovered from beneath the rubble of buildings destroyed in Gaza City, Middle East Eye reported. The burials marked the discovery of dozens of bodies from collapsed structures in the densely populated enclave.

Families identified and laid to rest relatives killed in the destruction of residential and commercial buildings across the city.
dek: Mass funerals held for over 100 Palestinians unearthed from rubble in Gaza City Hundreds of Palestinians have gathered for mass funerals for some 105 people whose remains were recovered from beneath the rubble of buildings which Israel destroyed in Gaza City…
title: Mass funerals held for 105 Palestinians recovered from Gaza City rubble
